# Yundera/AppStore — Lidarr

**Verdict: ERRORED · top severity Major · risk score 13** — the static half completed; the functional half could not run because **no demo instance was usable** (infra, not an app fault).

**Audit date:** 2026-08-03 · **Store version:** `lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:3.1.0` · **Compose:** `Apps/Lidarr/docker-compose.yml@main` (blob `77689b92`) · **Scope:** `n-a` (no compose_base — audit, not a PR) · **Depth requested:** full

---

## Summary

Lidarr's compose is a clean copy of the shipped Servarr family pattern (identical in structure to `Apps/Sonarr`, `Apps/Radarr`, `Apps/Prowlarr`): pinned image, correct Caddy/`pcs` wiring, complete store metadata, and all app state mapped under AppData. Three checklist deviations were found (1 Major, 3 Minor), none of them security- or data-loss-class, so **no Critical finding exists**.

The audit is nevertheless returned as **errored**, not as a compliance verdict: `depth=full` requires every mandatory functional phase to run, and **zero phases could be executed** — both demo PCS instances were down. Per the Functional Review Protocol's binding 2026-07-17 amendment (rule 4) and the orchestrator's binding 2026-07-07 amendment (rule B4), a mandatory phase that is `errored` can never yield `compliant`, and infra failure must not be recorded as a verdict about the app. This is a **retry**, not a judgement on Lidarr.

---

## Functionality (functional review — COULD NOT RUN)

**Demo host selected: none.** Per the binding *demo host selection* amendment (2026-07-17), the Demo Management board at `https://app.nasselle.com/demo/admin/manage` is the source of truth and only a `✅ Ready` instance may be used. The board was read twice (initial load + one reload to rule out a transient render) in a fresh isolated context `functional-Lidarr-audit`:

| Instance | Status | Time Remaining | Last Cleanup | Last Error |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `demostaging1.inojob.com` | **❌ Error** | 16.0h | 7/31/2026, 12:09:45 AM | `Request failed with status code 404` |
| `demostaging2.inojob.com` | **❌ Error** | 8.0h | 7/31/2026, 4:06:36 PM | `Request failed with status code 404` |

Neither instance is `✅ Ready`, so **neither qualifies** — the `> 1h` Time-Remaining rule never comes into play, since status gates first. Both also show a last successful cleanup of 7/31 against next-cleanup dates of 8/4–8/5, i.e. the whole pool has been stuck since 2026-07-31. `🧹 Trigger Cleanup` was **not** clicked (forbidden — it resets a shared instance).

Per amendment rule 4, the functional phases are recorded as `errored` with note `no-demo-available`. Per the strict-full-run amendment rule 3, `errored` is the correct value here and `skipped`/`not-attempted` is inexpressible — **no phase was skipped by choice**; the harness was denied a host.

| Phase | Result | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A — Session | **errored** | `no-demo-available` — no `✅ Ready` host to log into |
| C — Fresh install (+ duration) | **errored** | `no-demo-available` — never reached; **install duration unmeasured** |
| D — Discover APP_URL | **errored** | `no-demo-available` — not derivable without an install |
| E8 — Works immediately | **errored** | `no-demo-available` |
| E9 — Auth gate | **errored** | `no-demo-available` — Lidarr's onboarding gate **unverified** (see the Major finding) |
| E10 — Clean boot (console/5xx) | **errored** | `no-demo-available` |
| F — Zero-config usability | **errored** | `no-demo-available` — mandatory, not optional; denied by infra |
| G — Data persistence (real uninstall-keep-data → reinstall) | **errored** | `no-demo-available` — mandatory; the real uninstall/reinstall cycle was **never attempted because no host existed to install on**. Statically the persistence prerequisite is met (all state under `/DATA/AppData/lidarr/config`), but that is **not** a substitute for the live check. |
| G′ — Migration | **n-a** | No `PRIOR_VERSION` supplied (audit runs a single current version) — the one legitimate `n-a` |
| H — Verdict & cleanup | **pass** | Nothing was installed on any host, so there was nothing to uninstall; the audit browser page was closed and the pool left exactly as found |

`functional_verdict` = **errored** (not `not-functional`, and explicitly not `needs-human`).

**Cleanup:** satisfied on this exit path. No app was installed on either demo instance, no `🧹 Trigger Cleanup` was pressed, and the isolated browser context's page was closed.

---

## Conclusion

**ERRORED · top severity Major · risk score 13** — retry when the demo pool recovers.

- Lidarr is **not** being blamed: the static review is complete and clean of Critical findings, and its persistence design is sound.
- It is **not** eligible for `compliant` regardless: it carries 1 Major + 3 Minor checklist failures, so even a fully green functional run would land it at **non-compliant · Major (risk 13)**. The Major (missing `rationale.md` for onboarding-based auth) is a one-file fix; the three Minors are one-liners — and `cpu_shares: 10` plus the missing `PUID`/`PGID` env pair should be fixed across the whole Servarr family (`Sonarr`, `Radarr`, `Prowlarr`) at the same time.
- **Blocking issue is infra:** both `demostaging1` and `demostaging2` have been in `❌ Error` (`404`) since 2026-07-31. No app audit at `depth=full` can produce a compliance verdict until at least one instance returns to `✅ Ready` with more than 1h remaining.
